The Technocracy's explorers of the deep – outer space, the Deep Umbra and the dimensions beyond.

Affiliation: Technocracy

system.focus: The frontier must be mapped and made safe. Void Engineers work through Dimensional Science, spacecraft and exploratory technology, charting the void and defending reality's edges from what lurks beyond.
